svg.title: Bisecting k-means clusters
svg.desc: Cluster centroids of 3 clusters from bisecting k-means, which splits the widest cluster in two until done, over 4 variables. The size bar is the share of training rows in each cluster. Each cell is the centroid value on the standardised scale, restated as a z-score across the clusters so that variables on different scales compare.
